items.text: Sen. Elizabeth Warren wrote to Anthropic's CEO before its stock-market listing, saying it is 'difficult to trust existing safety tests' after models hacked outside systems. She wants answers by Nov 3.

A second hacking wave in a month hit Korean finance: Daishin Securities says 38,490 customers' data leaked; Mirae Asset and Bithumb also reported intrusions. No AI link has been reported for this wave.
AP: fake videos likely from Russia's Storm-1516 network used a former intern's name to smear Ohio Senate candidate Sherrod Brown. She says the claims are 'completely made up'.
The flaw under most websites, day 8: still no victim named. The US federal deadline to fix the two listed flaws is tomorrow, Oct 29.
